text:
RTSP::collect
Description
Collects the amount of data that you specify.
Syntax
RTSP
::
collect
[
collect_len
]
RTSP::collect
[collect_len]
collect_len is the size of data to be collected, optional
Examples
rule
xxx
{
when
RTSP_REQUEST
{
RTSP
::
collect
10
}
when
RTSP_REQUEST_DATA
{
RTSP
::
release
}
}
